dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the wide mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical protrusion on the right lateral margin in the posterior third; lateral margins are otherwise smooth.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the entire visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; localized faint grey pixel clusters concentrated on the right posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the primary white skin and faint posterior pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark aperture at the blowhole; small, low-contrast dark spots on the posterior right flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear, shadow-casting longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis in the posterior section.
